blocks.text: This document describes how to use the Trade Marks Classification Search.
The Trade Marks Classification Search searches a database of over 200,000 pre-approved goods and services in the 45 classes.

The Trade Marks Classification Search is available to examiners via RIO Dashboard > Register Search, under the heading ‘Classification search’ accessible from the drop-down menu in the top right corner of the screen.
For external users, the Trade Marks Classification Search is also available from the Advanced Search screen of the Australian Trade Mark Search.

Searching for Goods and Services
chunks.text: This document describes how to use the Trade Marks Classification Search. The Trade Marks Classification Search searches a database of over 200,000 pre-approved goods and services in the 45 classes. The Trade Marks Classification Search is available to examiners via RIO Dashboard > Register Search, under the heading ‘Classification search’ accessible from the drop-down menu in the top right corner of the screen. For external users, the Trade Marks Classification Search is also available from the Advanced Search screen of the Australian Trade Mark Search.

blocks.text: Important notes:
Can select between Semantic search or Keyword search, with Semantic the default
For Semantic search, can select to sort by relevance or class
Class Headings may be viewed by selecting the ‘Goods’ and ‘Services’ tabs
Can access complete class lists and read a description of the class by clicking on the Class Number heading under the ‘Goods’ and ‘Services’ tabs

blocks.text: Important notes:
Returns up to 100 results

14. Annex A5 - Using the Trade Marks Classification Search
Search Results Screen – Keyword Search
chunks.text: Important notes: Searching for CAR returns CAR and CARS but not CARPET, CARRIAGE, CARBON etc Returns up to 10,000 results Can filter results by ‘Goods’, ‘Services’, or by classes using Filter Results function Can jump to results in a class by clicking on the class number under Filter Results function Can access complete class lists and read a description of the class by clicking on the Class Number heading

blocks.text: Important notes:
Can conduct part word keyword search using the asterisk (in this case a search for CAR-)
Searching for CAR* returns CAR and CARS and CARPET, CARRIAGE, CARBON etc
Searching for *CAR* would return CAR, CARS, CARPET, HYDROCARBON, MASCARA, CARE, PLACARD etc
Can use the * with AND or OR operators
Searching for CARD* AND IDENT* will find IDENTITY CARDS, IDENTIFICATION CARDS, CARDS FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES etc

chunks.text: Important notes: Can conduct part word keyword search using the asterisk (in this case a search for CAR-) Searching for CAR* returns CAR and CARS and CARPET, CARRIAGE, CARBON etc Searching for *CAR* would return CAR, CARS, CARPET, HYDROCARBON, MASCARA, CARE, PLACARD etc Can use the * with AND or OR operators Searching for CARD* AND IDENT* will find IDENTITY CARDS, IDENTIFICATION CARDS, CARDS FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES etc

blocks.text: Important notes:
Can conduct keyword searches for a combination of terms with the inclusion of the word ‘and’. This can help reduce results
This search will show all claims in all classes that contain both terms
You may conduct this search with AND in capitals or lowercase

blocks.text: Important Notes:
Can access complete class lists and class explanations by clicking on the Class Number in the Search Results screen
First paragraph is the Class Heading. This is a general outline of the kinds of goods or services that belong in the class, and is not exhaustive
Second paragraph is the class explanation. This gives further guidance on the kinds of goods or services that are found in the class, and why they are classified in the class rather than elsewhere
The complete class lists are for information only and should not be copied directly into applications
